name: Outpost Echo 3D
author: Cyberdelia
help: Restore five sectors of Outpost Echo. Wheel turns. Select toggles walking. Hold Prev to reverse, Next interacts. Tap Play to use a tool; hold Play to switch Pulse, Scanner and Decoder. Menu pauses. Restore power, find the access card, activate the relay and reach the exit. Scan for hidden service panels. Progress is saved at pickups, terminals and when leaving. Your music keeps playing.

options.name: difficulty
options.title: Security
options.help: Robot detection and damage. Explorer is a gentler expedition.

achievements.name: quiet
achievements.title: Ghost in the Machine
achievements.text: Clear a sector without taking damage.
